meta.name: MiscBox tools manifest
meta.note: Download manifest for bootstrap.ps1. All URLs were probed live on 2026-10-24; SHA256 is checked when present, empty means the vendor publishes no stable hash for that asset.
meta.sha256_policy: sha256 is filled only where this project verified the exact bytes by downloading and using them. hashcat and nmap publish a PGP signature (.asc) rather than a stable hash file, so their sha256 is intentionally blank; bootstrap still verifies the archive extracts and the entry point runs. Never hand-type a hash you did not compute from the real file.

tools.name: CyberChef 离线版
tools.note: Release asset name carries a commit hash suffix; the archive still unpacks to CyberChef_v11.5.0.html.

tools.name: nmap
tools.note: nmap publishes no win64 zip for 7.992, only this NSIS installer. It is extracted with 7-Zip, never executed, so no registry keys are written.

tools.name: hashcat
tools.note: Must stay in its own directory (needs OpenCL/).

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.note: Installer is a 7z self-extracting archive; extract with 7z x, do not run it.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.note: Hosted on SourceForge (mirror redirect). exiftool.org links here, so a direct exiftool.org/exiftool-*.zip URL returns 404.

tools.name: Strawberry Perl portable
tools.note: ~1 GB. Needed by 7z2john.pl. Both perl/bin and c/bin must be on PATH at runtime.

tools.name: pngcheck
tools.note: Source only. Prebuilt Windows binaries are not published upstream; build with MSYS2/MinGW or supply your own pngcheck.exe.

tools.name: foremost
tools.note: Source only, needs MinGW to build. Supply your own compiled foremost.exe next to foremost.conf.

tools.name: StegSolve
tools.note: Author has not declared a redistributable license. Obtain from the original source.

tools.name: ARCHPR
tools.note: Commercial software. Purchase from Elcomsoft; only for your own archives and authorized work.

tools.name: Wireshark
tools.note: Installer requires admin and offers Npcap through its own wizard. Not silently installable. Only needed for live capture; pcap FILE analysis works with just the Wireshark install.

tools.name: Volatility 3
tools.note: Installed into its own venv. Requires a Python 3.10+ base interpreter.

tools.name: theHarvester
tools.note: The PyPI package named theHarvester is an unrelated placeholder; install from source.

tools.name: binwalk
tools.note: Needs a Windows compatibility patch before it installs. See docs/06-取证.md.

tools.name: Npcap
tools.note: Kernel driver; install path is fixed at C:\Windows\System32\Npcap and cannot be changed. The free edition refuses silent install (/S reports that silent installation is only supported in Npcap OEM), so the GUI wizard must be run by hand and needs UAC approval. Only needed for live capture and nmap SYN scans; pcap FILE analysis works without it.
